snippet.title: 1000 Deaths: Wishlist Now!
snippet.description:
Wishlist 1000 Deaths here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141260/1000_Deaths/ 

ABOUT 1000 DEATHS:
1000 Deaths is a gravity-bending 3D platformer where your choices matter. What you choose defines the game's levels, mechanics, and story. Dash through platforming hubs and decide your character's fate while exploring surreal worlds. Speedrun, or don't! 
https://1000deaths.tv/ 

ABOUT PARIAH INTERACTIVE: 
Pariah Interactive is an independent game and XR development studio based in Brooklyn, New York, and Mumbai, India, that creates surreal experiences about real life. Pariah’s current in-house production is 1000 Deaths, a 3D-platformer video game about confronting interpersonal conflicts. Pariah has been the development partner for work  exhibited at the MoMA, Tribeca Immersive, Superblue Miami, the New Museum, and more. 

FOLLOW US ON SOCIALS!
